records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2023, we generated $928.7 million in total revenue, with a revenue mix of: cloud subscriptions 27%; software license 2%; maintenance 15%; services revenue 53%; and hardware 3%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cloud Subscriptions and Software License revenue: In the full year ended 2023, cloud subscriptions revenue was 93% of total cloud and software license revenue.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $301.4 million, $238.4 million, and $196.4 million for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2022 and 2021, respectively, which represents approximately 32%, 31%, and 30% of our total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2022 and 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our R&D expenses for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2022 and 2021 were $126.8 million, $111.9 million, and $97.6 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For 2023, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $246.2 million and have generated a cumulative total of $611.0 million for the three years ended December 31, 2023.
